text: おれを　おこらすなよ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: This verb shape means making someone do something. おこらす is the short spoken form of おこらせる = 'make someone angry'.

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after the plain form of a verb is a blunt 'don't'. おこらすなよ = 'don't make me mad'.
